extracted.intended_audience: readers and students of classic Renaissance satire (general readership, literature students)
extracted.subtask_description: A prose excerpt from François Rabelais' Gargantua and Pantagruel — a comedic, grotesque, and digressive chapter of Renaissance satirical narrative full of physical jokes, mock-heroic episodes, and anecdotal burlesque. The page is a literary text rather than an instructional or evaluative guideline.
